title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Strikes016 — Recoil-Loaded Second Strike Debt

principle.pocket: THE FIRST HIT'S RECOIL IS THE SECOND HIT'S ANTICIPATION.
principle.causal_thesis: A committed first strike creates rotational recoil instead of ending the phrase. The pelvis continues through a controlled overrun while the first limb is braked; that counter-rotation pulls the opposite shoulder and hand into a loaded rear pocket. The second strike then spends that stored recoil before the body can reset. Recovery pays both impacts at a displaced address.
principle.novelty_vs_canonical_003_015: Unlike offhand countertorque debt, the opposite side does not merely catch rotational debt; it converts that debt into a second offensive commitment. Unlike limb/root overrun, the overrun is not only repaid: it becomes the causal load for a different striking limb and a second explicit contact.

keys.name: CANTED_READY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root sits rear-left of the target; right shoulder is slightly back, left hand floats forward as a loose measure.
keys.causal_role: Asymmetric baseline with visible open negative space between striking hand and target.

keys.name: REAR_COIL_FIRST
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis drops back/right into rear support while the right hand retracts farther than the shoulder.
keys.causal_role: Specific first-strike anticipation: pelvis and rear foot own the stored rotation before the hand accelerates.

keys.name: FIRST_DRIVE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis drives forward and rises; right shoulder begins to outrun the chest while lead foot accepts weight.
keys.causal_role: Root/support earns the first strike; the hand crosses a large distance only after pelvis commitment.

keys.name: FIRST_PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root is still moving forward; right fist stops one cell short of the upper contact while left hand folds toward the ribs.
keys.causal_role: Distinct precontact gap before the first hit; opposite hand is already positioned to receive recoil.

keys.name: FIRST_CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Right fist meets the upper target contact while pelvis has one more authored forward beat available.
keys.causal_role: Explicit first impact. It is a causal event, not merely the spatial endpoint of root motion.

keys.name: FIRST_HIT_ROOT_OVERRUN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis advances and drops after the fist leaves contact; striking hand recoils down/in while the opposite hand folds low toward the ribs, avoiding a symmetric spread.
keys.causal_role: The first impact creates visible recoil debt while the root still owns forward momentum; the asymmetrical fold is the handoff into the opposite-side load.

keys.name: RECOIL_LOADS_OPPOSITE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lead support compresses; chest yaws past pelvis, right hand folds across center, and left hand is dragged deep behind the opposite shoulder.
keys.causal_role: First-hit recoil becomes second-strike anticipation. The opposite hand is loaded by body counter-rotation rather than independently posed.

keys.name: SECOND_DRIVE_FROM_DEBT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis rebounds left/up while chest snaps forward/right; left hand cuts across from the recoil pocket.
keys.causal_role: Second strike spends the stored first-impact recoil before the body can restack.

keys.name: SECOND_PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Wide support catches rotation while left fist arrives one cell short of the lower contact; right arm trails behind the torso.
keys.causal_role: Distinct second precontact; the first limb now acts as secondary lag rather than a reset guard.

keys.name: SECOND_CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left fist meets the lower target contact while pelvis is braced between widened feet and torso rotation peaks.
keys.causal_role: Second explicit impact proves the first recoil was converted into offense, not merely absorbed.

keys.name: SECOND_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis stays caught while chest and left shoulder continue past the contact line of force; right hand remains late.
keys.causal_role: Authored torso overshoot after the second hit prevents the phrase from ending on contact.

keys.name: FIRST_LIMB_SECONDARY_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root begins to recover left while the right hand still trails low and the left elbow folds only partway.
keys.causal_role: Secondary lag preserves the two-impact history after the root has begun recovery.

keys.name: SUPPORT_CATCH_RESIDUAL_TORQUE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis counterleans into the rear foot; shoulders restack unevenly while both hands remain offset from ready.
keys.causal_role: Support, not an arm snap, catches remaining rotational debt from the two contacts.

keys.name: DISPLACED_REENTRY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Ready re-entry remains five cells forward of K00 with wider feet and hands at unequal heights.
keys.causal_role: Recovery closes at a new address. Two impacts have changed the stance; there is no idle reset.

quality_history.highest_value_visible_defect: K05 first-hit consequence briefly opened both arms into a near-horizontal symmetric spread, reading as mannequin/T-pose instead of recoil becoming a load.
quality_history.concrete_correction: Mutated SAME Strikes016 K05 into an asymmetrical down/in striking-hand recoil plus low opposite-hand fold and deepened K06 opposite-hand rear pocket so first-hit counter-rotation visibly pulls the second limb into anticipation.

quality_history.verdict: The first strike is root-earned and has a clean precontact/contact break; K05 no longer blooms symmetrically. K05-K06 make the first-hit recoil fold the first limb while visibly dragging the opposite hand into a rear load. K07-K09 spend that stored counter-rotation into a distinct second precontact/contact at a different height. K10-K13 preserve torso overshoot, first-limb lag, wide support catch, and displaced re-entry without reverse interpolation or idle reset.

The phrase has an authored point of view: one hit causes the next. The deep opposite-hand pocket after impact is the memorable negative-space phase; the second strike arrives as debt expenditure rather than a separate combo pose. Economy is high without reading as placeholder motion.
